## Summary

Both the May 1 and November 7, 2026 guides describe using the Stripe Dashboard after deploying an Android app to Stripe SmartPOS Android devices. Use the Dashboard to monitor progress, investigate deployment issues, and deploy a new app if needed.

## May 2026 Dashboard workflow

In the Dashboard, go to **Terminal → Software**, select the app, then select the release version under **App info**. The May guide describes deployment status and reader counts for the selected release.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Pending | The device has yet to check the Terminal backend for updates. |
| Served | The app reached the device. The device will attempt to install it at the next reboot. |
| Installed | The app successfully installed on the device. |
| Failed | An error occurred during the installation attempt. |

The November guide retains the general guidance to monitor deployments in the Dashboard. The specific path, counts, and status definitions above come from the May capture.

terminal-features-apps-on-devices-monito.text: Monitor your Android apps on Stripe SmartPOS Android devices.
After you deploy your app, you can monitor its deployment progress using the Stripe Dashboard.
This allows you to investigate any issues during deployment and to deploy a new app, if needed.
choose the release version to view the deployment status and number of Stripe readers in that status.
The app has been served to the device and will attempt to install on the next reboot.

terminal-features-apps-on-devices-monito.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/apps-on-devices/monitor, November 7, 2026 still documents a fleet operator using Stripe Dashboard after deploying an Android app to Stripe SmartPOS Android devices to monitor progress, investigate issues and deploy a new app if needed. It routes to Troubleshooting and supplies no detailed Dashboard prerequisites or state definitions (new raw lines 5-13). May 1, 2026 describes the same purpose and adds the exact Dashboard Terminal > Software > app details > App info > release version path and counts of readers per status. Pending means the device has yet to check the Terminal backend for updates. Served marks delivery and a scheduled installation attempt at the next reboot. Installed marks successful installation. Failed marks an error during the attempt (old raw lines 6-21). The pinned pre-update source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-monitor summarized these historical details and overstated Served as installation on reboot. The revised source dates the Dashboard details to May and gives the next reboot as an attempt, reserving successful installation for Installed.
terminal-features-apps-on-devices-monito.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/apps-on-devices/monitor, source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-monitor retains the detailed May 1, 2026 workflow and adds the November 7, 2026 overview as evidence for Dashboard monitoring and investigation. November retains high-level Dashboard monitoring and investigation after deployment and the existing Troubleshooting route. Its omission of the step-by-step UI, release-level reader counts and four-status table is a capture content reduction and does not establish a runtime or UI removal (new raw lines 7-13, old raw lines 6-25). The revised source corrects Served to mean an installation attempt on the next reboot, with success and error represented by Installed and Failed respectively (new raw line 9, old raw lines 18-21). The revised source links back to stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices and keeps the existing Troubleshooting destination as navigation.
